LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_Report: You settled the fee for clearing the pass.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_ArriveLabel: The merchant has come in person
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_ArriveText:
The merchant who sent word has come himself, with only two hands along.

He skips the pleasantries entirely. He walks in, spreads a route map across the table and taps the pass - already circled twice in charcoal.

"I want to settle the fee face to face. Send that sort of thing through a third party and both sides end up sour about it."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_Greeting:
He sets the charcoal down.

"{Interviewer_labelShort}, I will show you my hand first: this load is not mine. Three shops put up the deposit between them. I am only the one who walks the road."

"I know the going rate. A camp that size, four hundred, thereabouts. I brought four hundred. It is on the cart outside."

He pauses, looks at you, and finishes the thought.

"But I will not hide the rest from you either. If this load is lost, it is those three shops that lose it, not me alone. If you want more, I can pay more - I just have to go back and explain it to them afterwards."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_OptFair: Take the going rate - 400 silver, a fair price
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_OptFree: No fee this time - the deposit is not his, leave it with the three shops
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_OptGouge: Push it to 800 - he cannot go around, and he cannot force the pass
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_OptDetails: Ask first who exactly is sitting in that pass
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_Details1: "Who?" He taps the charcoal against the two circles.\n\n"Not bandits. Bandits do not camp in a pass, and they do not sit there this long - these are waiting for a specific caravan that runs this line. My scout watched for three days. Two watch rotations, sentry posts, a palisade. That is warlord work, put out to feed on the trade road."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_Details2:
"So you do not have to rush on my account. They will not move soon - and if they do move, it is because something fatter came along first."

He rolls the map up.

"But do not sit on it forever either. I am not the only one who walks this line."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_FarewellGood:
He nods and tucks the charcoal back into his collar.

"Settled, then. The load goes out on the day I planned. When you move on the pass is your business."

At the door he turns back and adds one more thing:

"I will be walking this road for many years yet. Do the job once, and you have a regular."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_FarewellGouge:
He does not haggle and his face does not change. He simply fetches the other four hundred from the cart and stacks the bags neatly, one at a time.

"Eight hundred."

When he has finished he straightens up and puts the route map away.

"I will report that figure as it stands. When those three shops ask, I will tell them it was your price."

He is still courteous when he leaves. He just does not say "come to me again" this time.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_MsgFair: Settled at the going rate: 400 silver.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_MsgFree: You took no escort fee for this one.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_MercEscort_MsgGouge: You pushed the price to 800 silver. He paid it.
